conceptual_change: Introduce a minimum volatility threshold (ATR filter) to filter out noise-driven trades that contributed to the sub-optimal 0.33 win rate.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The baseline validation resulted in a win rate of 0.33 and a negative total return, indicating the entry logic is likely triggered by low-volatility market noise. Implementing an ATR-based filter will constrain entries to high-volatility regimes where directional momentum is more statistically significant.
